CLEAVE.rulesText: When you hit a creature with a melee attack, you can make a second melee attack against another creature within 5 ft of the first. The second hit deals the weapon’s damage only (no ability modifier unless negative).

GRAZE.rulesText: If you miss a creature with a melee attack, it still takes damage equal to the ability modifier used for the attack.

NICK.rulesText: When you wield a Light weapon in each hand, you can make the extra off-hand attack as part of your Attack action instead of using a bonus action.

PUSH.rulesText: When you hit a Large or smaller creature, you can push it up to 10 feet away from you in a straight line.

SAP.rulesText: When you hit a creature, it has disadvantage on its next Attack Roll before the start of your next turn.

SLOW.rulesText: When you deal damage to a creature, its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

TOPPLE.rulesText: When you hit a creature, it must make a Constitution saving throw or fall Prone.

VEX.rulesText: When you hit a creature, you have advantage on your next Attack Roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.
